name: @jeffreyjyz/opencode-shell-rc
description: Make the opencode agent shell load your zsh aliases and functions (via a fast ZDOTDIR shim), without paying for oh-my-zsh/compinit on every command.

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && bun build src/index.ts --outdir dist --target bun --external @opencode/plugin && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
